rows.text: DECODER: A decoder unit. They are prone to overheating. 5c
rows.name: DECODER

rows.text: RATIONS: Food in a small foil container. One provides all the nutrients for 12 hours. 10c
rows.name: RATIONS

rows.text: NIGHT VISION: A small energy cell that runs for approximately 12 hours. 15c
rows.name: NIGHT VISION

rows.text: OXYGEN O2: A small canister with enough air for approximately 12 hours. 20c
rows.name: OXYGEN O2

rows.text: *(S) BRUTE ENHANCER DRINK: Use to gain +1 damage to your next damage roll when using a Str weapon. 35c
rows.name: *(S) BRUTE ENHANCER DRINK

rows.text: *(S) ACUTE ENHANCER DRINK: Use to gain +1 damage to your next damage roll when using a Dex weapon. 35c
rows.name: *(S) ACUTE ENHANCER DRINK

rows.text: CYBERCON™ POWER CELL: A small power cell designed for the Cybercon™ implant unit. 50c
rows.name: CYBERCON™ POWER CELL

rows.text: *(S) SPEED ENHANCER DRINK: Use to gain +1 Def against an enemy’s next damage roll. 50c
rows.name: *(S) SPEED ENHANCER DRINK

rows.text: EXPLOSIVE ROUNDS: Use with Dex weapons. Spend one before making an attack to roll a d10 for damage instead of a d6 (+1). 50c
rows.name: EXPLOSIVE ROUNDS

rows.text: *(S) BRAIN ENHANCER DRINK: Use to gain +5 Int to next test. 75c

rows.text: *(S) MIGHT ENHANCER DRINK: Use to gain +5 Str to next test. 75c
rows.name: *(S) MIGHT ENHANCER DRINK

rows.text: *(S) NIMBLE ENHANCER DRINK: Use to gain +5 Dex to next test. 75c
rows.name: *(S) NIMBLE ENHANCER DRINK

rows.text: *(S) ACID WRAP: -2 pips from the acid track. 80c

rows.text: *(S) MED PACK: Use to replenish up to 4 lost HP. 80c
rows.name: *(S) MED PACK

rows.text: ARMOUR PIERCING ROUND: Use with Dex weapons. Spend one before making an attack and the enemy suffers -2 Def from the attack (+1 Armour Piercing Round). 80c
rows.name: ARMOUR PIERCING ROUND

rows.text: *(S) CLEANSING WRAP: -2 pips from the plague track. 130c
rows.name: *(S) CLEANSING WRAP

rows.text: *(S) BRAIN BOOSTER CAPSULE: Use to gain +5 Int until you next shade a pip on the time track. 150c
rows.name: *(S) BRAIN BOOSTER CAPSULE

rows.text: *(S) MIGHT BOOSTER CAPSULE: Use to gain +5 Str until you next shade a pip on the time track. 150c
rows.name: *(S) MIGHT BOOSTER CAPSULE

rows.text: *(S) NIMBLE BOOSTER CAPSULE: Use to gain +5 Dex until you next shade a pip on the time track. 150c
rows.name: *(S) NIMBLE BOOSTER CAPSULE

rows.text: OPEN CYBERCON™ PATCH: See table I – Implants for its details of use. 200c
rows.name: OPEN CYBERCON™ PATCH

rows.text: ULTRA POWER CELL: Has 5 charges that can be used to add power to the Cybercon™ unit, then discard. 250c
rows.name: ULTRA POWER CELL

rows.text: TRACKER: If in a utility belt slot gain +10 Int to Stalk tests. Does not require a combat action. 300c
rows.name: TRACKER

rows.text: RADIUM POWER CELL: Has 10 charges that can be used to add power to the Cybercon™ unit, then discard. 500c
rows.name: RADIUM POWER CELL

rows.text: CLOAK DISRUPTOR: If in a utility belt slot the captain only suffers -5 to their Str or Dex against enemies with the Cloaked ability. Does not require a combat action. 500c
rows.name: CLOAK DISRUPTOR

rows.name: SMART DISPLAY
